summary: Full e2e testing of SIROSOFT marketing site. Backend (7 pytest cases) all pass: contact create/list with persistence, Mongo _id properly excluded, invalid-email & empty-field validation return 422, emailed:false correctly returned. Frontend loads cleanly with all 6 sections (#hero #szolgaltatasok #folyamat #technologiak #referenciak #miert #kapcsolat) rendered, navbar sticky with HU/EN toggle (EN disabled), services dropdown hover opens with 6 items, CTA scrolls to contact. Contact form: all data-testids present, empty submit shows 4 'Kötelező mező' errors + error toast, service checkbox toggles visually (green accent state), valid submission POSTs successfully (200, emailed:false), shows 'Köszönjük!' success toast, and clears the form. ONE issue: invalid-email scenario shows native browser tooltip instead of Hungarian 'Érvénytelen e-mail cím' because input type='email' triggers HTML5 validation before React handler.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid email never shows the required Hungarian message 'Érvénytelen e-mail cím'. The <input type='email'> triggers HTML5 native validation tooltip (English: 'Please include an @ in the email address') which preempts form onSubmit, so React validate() never runs. Spec explicitly requires the Hungarian message.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Either change type='email' to type='text' on input-email, or add noValidate attribute to the <form> element in Contact.jsx so the React validate() runs and the custom errors render.

action_items: Fix invalid-email validation UX: add noValidate to <form> in /app/frontend/src/components/site/Contact.jsx (or change input type from 'email' to 'text') so the Hungarian 'Érvénytelen e-mail cím' message displays as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is fine and concise; Mongo _id correctly stripped via projection {"_id": 0}. ContactCreate uses EmailStr + min_length validation - good.
Email is intentionally OFF (no SMTP env vars set). _send_email_sync returns False fast - correct per spec.
Contact.jsx HTML5 type='email' conflicts with custom React validation - documented above.
All interactive components have data-testid attributes - good for testability.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed contact submissions in MongoDB during tests. Safe to leave or wipe (collection: contacts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_sirosoft_api.py covers root, contact CRUD, validation, persistence, Mongo _id leak check. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Only known issue is invalid-email custom Hungarian error message not displaying due to HTML5 native validation preempting it.
rca_of_the_issue: Invalid-email path: input has type='email'. On submit, browser runs HTML5 constraint validation FIRST and shows native tooltip + blocks form submission. React onSubmit handler (which calls validate() and sets errors.email='Érvénytelen e-mail cím') is never invoked. Mitigation: add `noValidate` prop to <form data-testid='contact-form' ...> OR change <input type='email'> to <input type='text'> on input-email. Empty-field path works because empty value is valid for type='email' (no required attribute), so the form fires onSubmit and React validate() catches the empty-string case.
